notes.title: Game demo updated!
notes.notes: [p]After several months of development, alongside working on the lategame content, we've also tweaked the earlygame content to improve everyone's experience with the demo![/p][p]As we don't have any publisher to help us advertise, if you enjoyed our game, please consider recommending it to your friends! It helps a lot![/p][p][/p][p][b]Demo Update Patch Notes below:[/b][/p][p]Game Contents:[/p][p]- Tweaked the danmaku in Stage 1 and Stage 2[/p][p]- Tweaked the in-game UI and added a UI display for Tactical Skills[/p][p]- Tweaked the Tutorial Stage and fine-tuned parts of the explanations[/p][p]Game System Adjustments:[/p][p]- Increased rate of innate resource gain in Loop 1[/p][p]- Loop 2 - Reality Side: Greatly increased rate of gaining extra lives, decreased rate of gaining Spell Cards[/p][p]- Loop 2 - Dream Side: Greatly increased rate of gaining Spell Cards, decreased rate of gaining extra lives[/p][p]- Greatly decreased the resource gain from capturing Spell Cards in different difficulties[/p][p]- Adjusted the impact of using Spell Cards or Tactical Skills on Spell Card Bonuses, as broadly follows:[/p][p]  - When in Reality Side, Spell Card Bonuses start with 200% initial value and don't decrease over time[/p][p]  - When in Dream Side, Spell Card Bonuses start with 50% initial value and decreases by up to 50% over time[/p][p]  - Activating Spell Card Declarations will still immediately fail the Spell Card, releasing a Spell Card Attack or Tactical Skill will cause the current Spell Card Bonus to be divided by 1.5, and Spell Card Bonus reaching 0 will also be considered as failing the Spell Card[/p][p]Shottype Adjustments:[/p][p]- Reimu (Tactical Skill): Decreased damage by 50%, increased rate of conversion of enemy bullets to firepower from 80% to 120%, invincibility frames after using Tactical Skill increased from 180 frames to 210 frames[/p][p]- Marisa (Tactical Skill): Increased damage by 15%[/p][p]- ReimuB (Shot): Increased damage of unfocused shot by 80% and focused shot by 13%[/p][p]- MarisaB (Shot): Increased damage of unfocused shot by 20%, unfocused/focused shots now share equal damage[/p][p]Other Details:[/p][p]- Optimized the resource gain display from capturing Spell Cards[/p][p]- Optimized the damage display from damage caused by Tactical Skills[/p][p]- Optimized the text when loading stages and adjusted behavior to continue the game when pressing Shoot/Enter[/p][p]- Optimized the BGM looping when pausing/unpausing in Spell Practice[/p][p]- Optimized much of the codebase, improved performance when amount of danmaku is higher, and improved game stability[/p][p]- Decreased delay time when skipping dialogue to 45 frames[/p][p]- Fixed initial resource settings not working in Stage Practice[/p][p]We plan to update the danmaku in Stage 3 over the next few months. We welcome everyone's valuable advice, and we'll take them into consideration and make adjustments! Please recommend our game to your friends! Thank you!![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes of Pre3 fix3 - Optimizations & New Difficulty Temporarily Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Difficulty Temporarily Available[/h1]
After clearing Lunatic difficulty, you can now press Shift at the difficulty selection panel to enter the other side of the world—
[b]Ascended[/b]!*
"What you see is but a dream; what you do becomes reality.
Once you tread this path, past joys and sorrows fade into insignificance.
Seize possibilities as rare as finding a needle in the ocean, or drown in the storm of bullets.
This is the impossible challenge. Ascend the supreme ladder, and you shall gaze upon the astrolabe of dreams and reality."

In this difficulty:

You will face torrential trials with drastically intensified bullet patterns
[b]Lose 2 lives on hit, and 4 lives when the boss is present![/b]
Start with 16 Lives, maximum 32 Lives
Natural resource recovery and Power acquire efficiency are significantly reduced
This difficulty is extremely challenging. We recommend playing after a few drinks—no guarantee of passing through. This mode will close after the festival.

*The Ascended difficulty surpasses Lunatic, equivalent to Overdrive/Ultra.

[h1]Bug Fixes & Bullet Pattern Adjustments[/h1]

Reduced enemy HP in the Spell Card tutorial section and lowered bullet pattern difficulty in the combat training section
Adjusted parameters for certain bullet patterns
Optimized Lunatic difficulty unlock logic

notes.title: Patch Notes of Trail Version Pre3 fix2
notes.notes:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
After days of dedicated work, we've addressed critical issues and implemented optimizations including:
[list]
[*] Switched default graphics backend to significantly improve compatibility
[*] Optimized core systems and fixed numerous bugs
[*] Comprehensive adjustments to bullet patterns, game parameters and resource balancing
[/list]
Further optimizations are planned for the trial version, with another update expected within the next week focusing on polish.

[h1]Details[/h1]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

Switched rendering backend to OpenGL for better compatibility (resolves launch failures on non-Vulkan systems)
Temporarily adapted tutorial controls for remapped keys (textures pending redesign)
Improved main menu navigation logic - pressing opposite directional inputs now prioritizes moving to "Start Game"
Added and implemented boss name font
Added 2-second dialogue skip delay (now applied to first three stages)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Fixed possible game crush when adjusting resolution
Fixed random blackscreen during gameplay
Fixed crash when randomly switching tracks in Music Room
Fixed next song in shuffled playlists occasionally repeating current track
Eliminated frame drops during Stage 2 Final Spell (Magic A high-speed lightning phase)
Fixed Marisa being unable to graze when Special gauge is full
Corrected score calculation after continuing
Fixed tutorial stage auto-completion when accessed via Stage Practice
Addressed incorrect loop counter applications
Resolved Stage 3 midboss severe lag source
Fixed Stage 2 Tutorial rapid C-button explosion bug
Restored BGM after skipping dialogues
Prevented shortcut key crashes when confirmation windows are active in pause menu
Fixed Spell Practice allowing Bomb usage after "Save Replay & Return" due to uncleared Stage data
Missing Stage 3 midboss tracks in Music Room now can be unlocked in right position
Fixed the collision size of bullet
Fixed a incidental typographical error of pause menu tip

[h2]Resource System Adjustments[/h2]

Slightly reduced natural resource regeneration in 1st loop
Moderately increased resource rewards for capturing enemy Spell Cards
Reduced Dream Pointer affinity impact from Spell/Bomb usage

[h2]Bullet Pattern Changes[/h2]
[Easy]
Stage1: Adjusted 1st Spell & 2nd Non-Spell visuals
Stage2: Optimized 1st/2nd/3rd Non-Spells and 1st/3rd Spells
Stage3: Refined 1st Spell & 2nd/3rd Non-Spell presentations

[Normal]

Stage1: Enhanced 1st Spell & 2nd Non-Spell visuals
Stage2: Improved 1st/2nd/3rd Non-Spells and 1st/3rd Spells
Stage3: Adjusted 1st Spell & 2nd/3rd Non-Spell patterns

[Hard]

Stage1: Major 1st Non-Spell overhaul + minor 1st/2nd Spell difficulty bumps
Stage2: Moderate 1st/2nd Spell enhancements + 2nd Non-Spell rhythm/pattern redesign + 3rd Non-Spell/Spell polish
Stage3: Slight 1st Spell/2nd Non-Spell/4th Spell intensification + 3rd Non-Spell pattern overhaul

[Lunatic]

Stage1: Drastically reworked 1st Non-Spell + minor 1st/2nd Spell tweaks
Stage2: Heavily boosted 1st Spell & Stage2-2nd Spell difficulty + 2nd Non-Spell pattern/rhythm redesign + 3rd Non-Spell/Spell refinements
Stage3: Complete 3rd Non-Spell pattern reconstruction

notes.title: Issues and Solutions on the First Day of the Trial Version
notes.notes:
[i]As you can see, we are urgently fixing critical bugs that affect the gaming experience, which usually takes some time (and the main organizer and programmer still has to go to work, crying😭)[/i]

Below are the common questions and answers we summarized on the first day of the trial version.

[b]😡Why can't I unlock the Lunatic difficulty?[/b]
Please long press ↑ on the difficulty selection panel. We realize that this operation is counter-intuitive, and we will adjust the unlocking logic in the future.

[b]👀Why does the game show a white screen and then crash?[/b]
It is most likely that your computer does not support Vulkan. Please update your graphics card drivers (Nvidia, AMD, and Intel graphics cards need to find their respective drivers), then visit [url=https://sdk.lunarg.com/sdk/download/1.4.304.1/windows/VulkanSDK-1.4.304.1-Installer.exe]the LunarG Vulkan SDK official website[/url] to download and install the Vulkan SDK. 
No additional options need to be selected during installation.
After installation, press Win+R, type cmd, and press Enter. Execute the vulkaninfo command. If you can see the Vulkan version number and a large amount of text pops up, it means your computer now supports Vulkan.

[b]💥What should I do if the game reports an error?[/b]
We have fixed some issues that could cause errors, but some bugs still exist. If you encounter an error, please continue to provide feedback to us: take a screenshot and share it in the community along with the steps to reproduce the issue.

[b]🌃I entered the tutorial, and then the game screen went black. What should I do?[/b]
This issue cannot be stably reproduced, but we have roughly located the problem and will work on fixing it in the next few days. Generally, restarting the game should resolve it.

[b]🤔What can I try if I encounter a problem?[/b]
Update your graphics card drivers.
Restart your computer.
Uninstall and re-download the game.
Exit the game, delete the setting file and all files in the save folder in the game's root directory, then start the game.

Finally, we offer our sincere apologies. On one hand, as a fan-made project, we are limited in resources and may have some oversights, so we appreciate your understanding. On the other hand, we will strengthen our testing efforts to ensure that the full release does not encounter similar issues, ensuring that everyone enjoys the game and we can be happy too.

notes.title: Touhou: the Unreachable Oneiroborder Trial Version Player Manual
notes.notes:
Version: pre3 | Release Date: February 10, 2025

Thank you for playing the trial version of Touhou: the Unreachable Oneiroborder! This version focuses on showcasing core gameplay mechanics and early content exploration, offering approximately 40% of the full game's content. It aims to collect player feedback to optimize the official release. Please note that save data will likely not carry over to the official version.

🎮 Basic Controls Guide
Arrow Keys: Move character / Switch options
Z: Shoot / Confirm
X: Use Spell Card / Cancel
C: Use Tactical Skill
Left Shift: Enter slow-motion mode, switch character's shooting configuration, and display hitbox during this time
ESC: Open pause menu, where you can check your current status
Pause Menu + Q/T: Return to title screen
Pause Menu + R: Quick restart
Mouse Support: The UI supports mouse interaction.
Left Click (in menus or pause screen): Confirm
Right Click (in menus or pause screen): Cancel

🔍 Trial Version Content
Three stages, four original characters, and three boss fights.
Two playable characters with four different configurations each.
After clearing the game once, New Game+ is unlocked, activating the "Dream Pin" system.
In the settings, you can disable the "Continuous Release" option to experience a more controlled Spell Card release rhythm.

🐞 Known Issues & Notes
[u][b][Important] Some players' PCs may not support Vulkan, which can cause the game to crash[/b][/u].
[Important] Ensure the game is launched in High-Performance Mode (using GPU).
Controller support is incomplete.
Some UI interactions may not feel intuitive—your feedback is welcome!
Some settings may require a game restart to take effect. We’ve fixed some of these issues, but others are still being worked on.
If you encounter critical errors, please verify the integrity of game files (Steam: Right-click the game → Properties → Local Files).
[Important] If your computer resolution is 16:10, please do not check the "full screen" mode, otherwise it will trigger rendering errors
If you unfortunately trigger this bug, you can find the "settings" file and Save folder in the game directory, delete them, and then reopen the game.
[Important] If you encounter game freezing when switching window resolution, please click on the upper right corner of the window to close the game and restart.

📢 Feedback & Support
Your feedback will directly influence the development of the official version!
Submit Feedback & Discuss: Share your thoughts directly in the QQ group or Discord community.
Report Bugs: Error logs are automatically saved in lstg_log.txt. Please include steps to reproduce the issue when submitting.

🚀 Upcoming Updates
Critical Bugs (crashes, game-breaking issues): These will be fixed immediately, and updates will be pushed as soon as possible.
Minor Bugs (slightly affecting gameplay): These will be addressed within two weeks, with updates pushed accordingly.
We apologize for any rushed aspects of the trial version and appreciate your understanding.

— Sincerely, Team Realborder
